summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting its transactional net asset value per share as of March 31, 2026, for multiple share classes ranging from $26.69 to $26.99. This routine NAV disclosure determines the price at which the company sells and repurchases its shares, reflecting standard periodic reporting for a closed-end interval fund. No merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. The filing merely provides updated net asset values required for ongoing share transactions, with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
